name: Web search for Ask
description: Ask the archive also draws on the web (hook ask.sources): the assistant writes a short English search query (the ask-expand prompt's web: line, checked for identifiers), Brave Search or DuckDuckGo answers, and the top pages are read for their best passage. Sends the query only, never the question or a report.

provider.label: Search engine
provider.help: ddg (DuckDuckGo's HTML page, no key) or brave (Brave Search API, needs a key)

fetch_pages.label: Pages read
fetch_pages.help: the top results read for their best passage; 0 = the search snippets only
